nodes.label: ResearchClawBench: Autonomous Scientific Research Benchmark
nodes.author: Wanghan Xu, Shuo Li, Tianlin Ye, et al.
nodes.rationale: Benchmark for evaluating end-to-end autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 domains; grounded in real published papers with hidden target papers.

nodes.label: ResearchClawBench Scientific Domains
nodes.rationale: Covers 10 domains: Astronomy, Chemistry, Earth Science, Energy Science, Information Science, Life Science, Material Science, Mathematics, Neuroscience, Physics.

nodes.label: Reference-Anchored Discovery Score (RADS)
nodes.rationale: Evaluation metric treating target paper as reference study; score of 50 denotes reference-level evidence, scores >50 indicate discovery potential.

nodes.label: ResearchHarness: Lightweight LLM Evaluation Tool
nodes.rationale: ReAct-style tool-use harness for native LLMs; provides web search, file operations, and code execution tools; supports context compaction.

nodes.label: Autonomous Agents Evaluated in ResearchClawBench
nodes.rationale: Seven agents: Claude Code, EvoScientist, Codex CLI, OpenClaw, ResearchClaw, ARIS Codex, Nanobot; plus 17 native LLMs via ResearchHarness.

nodes.label: ResearchClawBench Main Results
nodes.rationale: Best autonomous agent (Claude Code) averages 21.5/100; best LLM (Claude-Opus-4.7) averages 20.7; frontier mean 26.5; far from reliable re-discovery.

nodes.label: ResearchClawBench Error Analysis
nodes.rationale: Failures concentrate on Experiment Design Mismatch, Evidence Mismatch, and Scientific Core Missing; not execution or reporting failures.

nodes.label: ResearchClawBench Task Construction
nodes.rationale: Domain experts screen papers, extract core questions, organize literature and data, construct rubrics, package tasks, and cross-validate; ensures research value.

nodes.label: Expert-Curated Multimodal Rubrics
nodes.rationale: Decompose target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria; support both text and image evaluation; enable assessment of re-discovery vs. discovery.

nodes.label: Supplemental Quality Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Comprehensiveness, Depth, Instruction Following, Professionalism; weak correlation with rubric score; shows presentation quality exceeds content quality.

nodes.label: Resource-Score Relationship Analysis
nodes.rationale: Weak positive relationship between cost/runtime and score; suggests tasks may not lie within stable capability boundary; failures reflect goal misalignment not insufficient computation.

nodes.label: Research Paper: Autonomous Agent Benchmarking and Evaluation
nodes.author: Multiple authors (Shanghai AI Lab, et al.)
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive evaluation framework for autonomous agents across multiple scientific domains (Physics, Astronomy, Chemistry, etc.) using both autonomous agent systems and LLM-based approaches.

nodes.label: Physics_002: Random Quantum Circuit Sampling Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Evaluates computational power of random quantum circuit sampling on arbitrary geometries; requires XEB fidelity estimation from experimental bitstring counts and ideal probability distributions.

nodes.label: Physics_003: Floquet-Bloch States in Graphene via tr-ARPES
nodes.rationale: Experimental confirmation of Floquet-Bloch states in monolayer epitaxial graphene using time-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy; requires energy-momentum-resolved observation of replica bands.
